children: Empire Petroleum's revenue rose while its net loss narrowed year over year, as higher realized oil prices and increased natural gas and NGL prices more than offset lower production volumes. The company recorded a loss on derivatives amid higher market prices relative to its commodity derivative positions.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Total production was 185,214 Boe, down from 220,648 Boe, primarily due to natural decline and North Dakota wells being down for steam-unit projects.
: Rose approximately 25% year over year to $76.06 per barrel, including the impact of hedging contracts.
: Increased approximately 93% year over year to $17.86 per barrel, driven by higher overall market prices.
: Expense was approximately $1.9M versus approximately $0.4M, largely due to reclassified Texas project costs.
